The FloPlast 112mm half round external stop end in white is a uPVC guttering component designed to provide a secure closure for external drainage systems. This robust stop end is ideal for both new build installations and refurbishment projects, ensuring efficient rainwater management for various properties. Manufactured from durable uPVC, it offers excellent weather resistance and features pre-lubricated seals for straightforward fitting and a reliable connection. A pre-fitted gutter seal retaining clip system further assists with a fast and secure installation.
